name: Herbs de Provence
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical culinary amounts. Most herbs in the blend are naturally FODMAP-free and may have antimicrobial properties beneficial for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Use dried blend as-is or bloom in oil for deeper flavor
Add to roasted vegetables in last 10 minutes to prevent burning
Mix into olive oil for a quick marinade base
Store in airtight container away from light to maintain potency
alternatives: Individual herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from mixed herbs
Good source of vitamin K from dried herbs
Provides trace minerals like iron and calcium
